body.name: Anonymous Cat
body.description: ZCAT is a Solana-based meme token launched through StonkFun with a built-in holder reward mechanism. The token has a permanent 3% transfer tax, which is collected from ZCAT trading and transfers. These fees are used to generate rewards in Zcash (ZEC), which are distributed proportionally to eligible ZCAT holders. Rewards are automatically airdropped directly to holder wallets, with no staking, claiming, or wallet connection required. The amount distributed varies based on token activity and is not a fixed or guaranteed yield.

body.name: DarkSwap
body.description: DarkSwap is a privacy-focused swap interface for Solana-origin transactions. It currently provides two live manual-deposit routes: an existing private route powered by Houdini / HoudiniSwap and a Privacy Swap route built on the NEAR Intents 1Click API with confidential handling. Users can review a live quote and order details before manually sending funds from their own Solana wallet. DarkSwap does not require a wallet connection, does not sign or broadcast the user’s deposit transaction, and does not custody user funds. The project is also developing a cross-chain terminal on NEAR Intents and a separate Phase 2 product called the Dark Pool.
